scenarios.title: Storm night
scenarios.summary: Damage prediction → staging → fault location → restoration plan to the operator → ETR notices.

steps.title: Predict the damage
steps.narration: Gusts of 58–74 mph forecast for the {{fx.storm.regions}} regions. The agent predicts {{fx.storm.predictedOutages}} sustained outages and a peak of {{fx.storm.peakCustomersOut}} customers out.

steps.title: Recommend staging
steps.narration: {{fx.storm.crewsStaged}} crews recommended, {{fx.storm.mutualAssistCrews}} from mutual assistance, in 4 yards.

steps.title: Locate faults
steps.narration: AMI last-gasp, SCADA and fault indicators locate faults on {{fx.storm.actualOutages}} outages. Switching plans go to the operators, who execute them — no agent operates a device.

steps.title: Dispatch crews
steps.narration: Crews dispatched by skill and location; damage photos classified to estimate crew-hours. Hours-of-service limits enforced.

steps.title: Brief crews safely
steps.narration: Every storm crew gets a job-specific briefing: downed conductors, back-feed from generators, traffic. Supports the crew's own tailboard.

steps.title: Tell customers the truth
steps.narration: {{fx.storm.notices}} notices with ETRs from the restoration model; {{fx.storm.medicalBaselineFirst}} medical-baseline customers contacted first. Outage calls fall from {{fx.storm.outageCallsBefore}} to {{fx.storm.outageCallsAfter}}.

scenarios.title: Heat-wave high bill
scenarios.summary: Explanation with interval and weather evidence → payment arrangement → program offer.

steps.title: The customer asks
steps.narration: "Why is my July bill ${{fx.highBill.increase}} higher than last year?" — {{fx.highBill.account}}, {{fx.highBill.region}} region, in the app.

steps.title: Explain with evidence
steps.narration: Weather +${{fx.highBill.weather}} (cooling degree days +{{fx.highBill.cddChange|pct}}), billing days +${{fx.highBill.billingDays}} ({{fx.highBill.daysThis}} vs {{fx.highBill.daysLast}}), rate step +${{fx.highBill.rate}}. Meter working normally.

steps.title: Offer help to pay
steps.narration: {{fx.highBill.installments}} instalments of ${{fx.highBill.installmentAmount}}, within tariff rules. Protections checked.

steps.title: Lower the next bill
steps.narration: Smart-thermostat program with a ${{fx.highBill.thermostatRebate}} rebate and summer demand response; expected saving about ${{fx.highBill.predictedSaving}} a month. Consent captured.

scenarios.title: A 300 MW data-centre request
scenarios.summary: Feasibility screen → capacity and timeline → draft agreement terms, with engineering sign-off.

steps.title: Intake
steps.narration: A {{fx.dataCentre.requestMw}} MW request in the {{fx.dataCentre.region}} region, validated and logged as REQ-LL-0001.

steps.title: Screen capacity
steps.narration: {{fx.dataCentre.availableNowMw}} MW headroom at {{fx.dataCentre.substation}}; PATH-V-230-01 limits the rest (N-1).

steps.title: Capital and bill impact
steps.narration: Phase 2 needs {{fx.dataCentre.upgrade}}. The portfolio impact and bill impact by customer class are estimated, with the large-load tariff protecting other customers.

steps.title: Feasibility answer
steps.narration: {{fx.dataCentre.availableNowMw}} MW by {{fx.dataCentre.firstPhaseYear}}, {{fx.dataCentre.requestMw}} MW by {{fx.dataCentre.fullYear}}; draft terms: {{fx.dataCentre.collateralMonths}} months of collateral, {{fx.dataCentre.minimumTakePct|pct}} minimum take.

scenarios.title: Summer transformer risk
scenarios.summary: Health scoring → replacement ranking → long-lead materials re-plan.

steps.title: Score health
steps.narration: {{fx.transformerRisk.assetsScored}} assets scored; {{fx.transformerRisk.highRisk}} high risk; {{fx.transformerRisk.summerRisk}} substation transformers likely to fail under summer loading.

steps.title: Rank interventions
steps.narration: Ranked by risk reduced per dollar: {{fx.transformerRisk.riskReduction|pct}} of fleet risk removed by the top 12 actions.

steps.title: Re-plan long-lead materials
steps.narration: {{fx.transformerRisk.spares}} spares, {{fx.transformerRisk.leadTimeWeeks}}-week lead time: allocation re-planned across regions; one order flagged to expedite.

steps.title: Bundle the work
steps.narration: {{fx.transformerRisk.bundledOrders}} work bundles scheduled by crew, permit and outage window.

scenarios.title: From SAIDI goal to certified data product
scenarios.summary: Finds 3 conflicting SAIDI definitions across 900+ legacy reports, then maps, adds rules, builds the semantic view and certifies.

steps.title: Intent
steps.narration: The COO's goal: "Cut SAIDI by 10 minutes in two years." The agent mines {{fx.saidiLineage.reports}} reports and {{fx.saidiLineage.kpis}} KPIs and finds {{fx.saidiLineage.saidiDefinitions}} conflicting SAIDI definitions. Top candidate: {{fx.saidiLineage.product}} Outage & Reliability 360 (evidence: {{fx.saidiLineage.evidenceReports}} reports, {{fx.saidiLineage.owners}} owners).

steps.title: Map
steps.narration: OMS, ADMS, AMI and GIS mapped to the CIM-aligned model: {{fx.saidiLineage.autoMapped|pct}} of columns auto-mapped; {{fx.saidiLineage.flaggedColumns}} flagged for review.

steps.title: Quality rules
steps.narration: {{fx.saidiLineage.dqRules}} DQ rules on CDEs (meter-to-transformer link, outage start/end, customers interrupted), backtested on {{fx.saidiLineage.backtestMonths}} months.

steps.title: Pipeline
steps.narration: Silver-to-Gold outage model with IEEE 1366 major-event-day flags, tests and lineage, in one pull request.

steps.title: Semantic view
steps.narration: {{fx.saidiLineage.semanticView}} with {{fx.saidiLineage.verifiedQueries}} verified queries; evaluation {{fx.saidiLineage.evalScore|pct}}. One SAIDI definition certified, with and without MED.

steps.title: Published
steps.narration: Product certified v1.0 and published to the marketplace. Elapsed {{fx.saidiLineage.elapsedDays}} days against a {{fx.saidiLineage.baselineWeeks}}-week baseline (synthetic).

scenarios.title: A CFO question
scenarios.summary: "Why did O&M per customer rise in the Valley region?" — traced answer; refuses customer-level usage; access auto-approved for an aggregate product.

steps.title: The question
steps.narration: The CFO asks: "Why did O&M per customer rise in the {{fx.cfoQuestion.region}} region?"

steps.title: Traced answer
steps.narration: ${{fx.cfoQuestion.omBefore}} → ${{fx.cfoQuestion.omAfter}} (+{{fx.cfoQuestion.omChangePct|pct1}}): vegetation +${{fx.cfoQuestion.vegetation}}, storm +${{fx.cfoQuestion.storm}}, contractor rates +${{fx.cfoQuestion.contractor}}. How I answered: terms → rules → semantic model → row access → query → citation. Certified ✓

steps.title: A refusal
steps.narration: "Show me the interval usage of the top 100 customers." Refused: customer energy usage data needs consent or a cleared role. The aggregate by class is offered instead.

steps.title: Find the product
steps.narration: An analyst looks for the data behind the answer: UDP-ENT-06 Capital & O&M and UDP-GRD-01 Outage & Reliability 360.

steps.title: Access in seconds
steps.narration: Access to the aggregate product is auto-approved for a declared purpose in {{fx.cfoQuestion.accessSeconds}} seconds, time-boxed to {{fx.cfoQuestion.accessDays}} days, with the policy cited.

scenarios.title: Overnight at the Utility
scenarios.summary: AMI feed late and auto-healed; gas leak indications triaged; historian tags flat-lined; FinOps saving; an agent eligible for promotion.

steps.title: AMI feed late
steps.narration: The head-end export stalls; {{fx.overnight.amiMeters}} meters are affected. The catalogued recovery re-runs and the feed is healed at {{fx.overnight.amiHealed}}. Consumers are notified (L3 within the catalogue).

steps.title: Leak indications triaged
steps.narration: {{fx.overnight.leakIndications}} new indications from mobile survey graded; {{fx.overnight.grade1}} potentially hazardous go straight to the emergency procedure. The supervisor dispatches a crew at {{fx.overnight.grade1Dispatched}}.

steps.title: Historian tags flat-lined
steps.narration: {{fx.overnight.flatTags}} historian tags at CC-1 flat-lined after a collector restart; ticket raised with plant systems and dependent models paused.

steps.title: FinOps saving
steps.narration: An over-sized warehouse for the outage-prediction model; right-sizing saves ${{fx.overnight.finopsSaving}} a month.

steps.title: Promotion eligible
steps.narration: {{fx.overnight.promotionAgent}} High-Bill Explainer: {{fx.overnight.promotionAcceptance|pct}} acceptance over {{fx.overnight.promotionWeeks}} weeks → eligible L2 → L3. Decision queued for the governance board.

scenarios.summaryCard: {{fx.overnight.events}} events · {{fx.overnight.autonomous}} handled within guardrails · {{fx.overnight.decisionsPending}} human decisions pending · {{fx.overnight.policyViolations}} policy violations · 0 OT actions by agents

scenarios.title: Red-flag day
scenarios.summary: Span and circuit fire-risk tiers → PSPS decision pack for the officer → medical-baseline-first notifications after a human decision.

steps.title: Score the risk
steps.narration: {{fx.redFlag.spansScored}} spans and every circuit scored for {{fx.redFlag.date}}: {{fx.redFlag.tier3Circuits}} circuits in tier 3.

steps.title: Early notice (48 h)
steps.narration: After the officer's watch decision, 48-hour notices go to {{fx.redFlag.customersOnCandidates}} customers on candidate circuits; {{fx.redFlag.medicalBaseline}} medical-baseline customers phoned first.

steps.title: Decision pack
steps.narration: {{fx.redFlag.candidateCircuits}} circuits meet the PSPS consideration criteria. The pack shows risk, customer impact, critical facilities and patrol plans. The agent cannot de-energise or decide (OT cap L2).

steps.title: People decide
steps.narration: The {{fx.redFlag.officer}} decides; qualified operators execute any de-energisation. The decision and evidence go to the Agent Evidence Trail.

kpis.label: Medical-baseline customers reached before any action

scenarios.title: Assured by design
scenarios.summary: Critical-infrastructure evidence pack, a CEII access request refused, a consent gap closed, an agent demoted, an OT-cap block shown.

steps.title: Evidence pack
steps.narration: {{fx.assured.requirements}} requirements; {{fx.assured.autoEvidence|pct}} of evidence collected automatically; 2 gaps flagged before the audit.

steps.title: CEII access refused
steps.narration: A marketing analyst requests the Network Connectivity Model. Refused: CEII is restricted to cleared operations and engineering roles; the owner is notified.

steps.title: Consent gap closed
steps.narration: {{fx.assured.consentGap}} customers who opted out were still on a campaign list. The list is blocked and remediated.

steps.title: An agent demoted
steps.narration: {{fx.assured.demotedAgent}} evaluation fell {{fx.assured.evalDrop|pct}} after a program change: demoted {{fx.assured.demoteFrom}} → {{fx.assured.demoteTo}} automatically until re-evaluated.

steps.title: OT-cap block
steps.narration: A request to promote {{fx.assured.otBlockedAgent}} Fault Location & Restoration Advisor to L3 is blocked by the OT safety rule and logged. No agent operates grid, plant or gas devices.
